info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Evaluation Reviews API
info.description: The Fraud Evaluation Reviews API enables businesses to submit reviews related to fraud assessments associated with specific banking accounts. This endpoint allows authorized users to provide insights and evaluations based on the fraud detection processes. Typical consumers include risk management teams and fraud analysts tasked with enhancing account security. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their fraud evaluation procedures, ensuring timely responses and improved management of potentially fraudulent activities.

post.summary: Submit a review for fraud evaluation.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific fraud evaluation case identified by ID RES-100045. The review will include necessary details for consideration in the evaluation process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit reviews for fraud evaluations associated with a specific account, identified by the RES-100045 identifier. The submitted data will help in assessing the validity of the fraud case.
